rules.size: size = the smallest tier holding at least 10 % of the tier-class TShips rows that can mount a laser firing the bullet (fewer is treated as an outlier row): small M5/M4/M3; medium M6/M8/TS/TS_PIRATE/TP/TM; big M7/MISSILE_FRIGATE/M2/M1/M0/TL/DRONECARRIER; other = only non-tier classes (drones, satellites, UFO, Kha'ak cluster, ...) mount it; unmounted = no ship mask admits its laser subtype or no TLaser row fires it; the TShips rows SS_SH_TURRET, SS_SH_TLS, SS_SH_TL_P, SS_SH_TL_P2 (a static turret and station-like rows with catch-all masks) are left out
rules.mounting: TShips col 18 | TCockpits col 8 of TShips cols 31,33,..41; bit = SG_LASER value (inferred)
